objective: Verify that the R7 package can be copied once to a fresh ordinary temporary directory, independently close there, and execute its documented local path without research-root or prior-identity dependencies.
procedure: Copy the package and document into one newly created operating-system temporary directory.
Verify the copied package with the production closure verifier.
From the temporary project directory, invoke only the copied bundled TXT converter using relative paths.
Verify exit status, expected minimal outputs, Stage3 A/B/overall PASS, input byte immutability, package byte immutability and absence of hardcoded research-root paths in the copied package.
Delete the temporary directory only after persisting digests and results in the H13 machine report.

claims.engineering: Package portability and documented ordinary use only.
claims.behavior: One exposed TXT task through the copied package; no PDF/DOCX, external API or professional legal claim.
claims.effect: Not evaluated; no source/package controlled pair is created by this stage.

acceptance: One copy is sufficient and package closure passes at the destination.
The local TXT path succeeds after the working directory changes and the original document remains byte-identical.
The package remains byte-identical and has no runtime filesystem dependency on the research root or prior result directory; immutable proposal provenance metadata is allowed.
Usage and component documentation distinguish automatic bare-agent capture from advanced manual-log compatibility and preserve configuration failure guidance.
